title: Steel Shutter Installer
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: Previous experience installing or repairing steel shutters, doors, or similar metalwork
description_text:
Position Overview 
 The successful candidate will be responsible for installing, maintaining, repairing, and servicing steel roller shutters, security doors, and related systems for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. The role requires strong technical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work safely and efficiently on-site.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Install steel roller shutters, security shutters, and related products.
 Perform maintenance, servicing, and repairs on existing shutter systems.
 Read technical drawings and follow installation specifications.
 Troubleshoot and resolve mechanical issues.
 Ensure all installations meet company quality and safety standards.
 Use hand and power tools safely and effectively.
 Maintain a clean and organized work area.
 Communicate professionally with clients and team members.
 Requirements: 
 TCN must have a valid Pre-departure course Certificate
 Previous experience installing or repairing steel shutters, doors, or similar metalwork.
 Good mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to use hand and power tools.
 Physically fit and comfortable working at heights when required.
 Strong attention to detail and commitment to workplace safety.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
